title: Genuine · adj.
subtitle: 「真的／真品的／真誠的／正當的」，究竟是哪一種 genuine？
description: 「真的／真品的／真誠的／正當的」，究竟是哪一種 genuine？

words.note: 使用者提供。authentic 是 genuine 最核心的近義詞之一，特別適合 art, documents, products, cuisine, cultural practices 等，強調不是偽造、仿製或冒牌。
words.example: Experts confirmed that the painting was authentic.

exercises.original: The museum confirmed that the manuscript was genuine.
exercises.zh: 博物館確認這份手稿是真品。
exercises.upgrade: authentic · 真正的；正宗的；真品的

options.explanation: museum verification + manuscript directly concerns authenticity rather than sincerity.

falseSynonyms.zh: 兩者高度接近；authentic 特別常用於真品、正宗文化、文件與簽名。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The signature is authentic. Her concern is genuine.

falseSynonyms.zh: sincere 主要描述人的情感、話語與意圖；物件真假通常不用 sincere。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON She gave a sincere apology. The painting is genuine.

falseSynonyms.zh: real 範圍更廣，表示實際存在；genuine 常多一層『不是偽造／不是裝出來』。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The danger is real. The document is genuine.

falseSynonyms.zh: bona fide 較正式，常涉及身份、資格、交易或法律地位；一般情緒不用 bona fide。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON He is a bona fide resident. Her gratitude was genuine.

falseSynonyms.zh: legitimate 強調正當、合理或合法；genuine 強調真實或真心。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON They raised a legitimate concern. Her concern was genuine.

falseSynonyms.zh: honest 強調不欺騙、說真話；genuine 還可以描述物品是真品。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Give me an honest answer. This coin is genuine.

falseSynonyms.zh: heartfelt 強調深厚感情，常用於 thanks/sympathy/wishes；genuine 不一定情感強烈。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Please accept my heartfelt thanks. His interest was genuine.

falseSynonyms.zh: artificial 表示人造／不自然；有些人工物品仍然可以是 genuine products，因此兩者不是簡單反義關係。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The flowers are artificial. The leather is genuine.
